title: Obsolete Http Web Request Mgt. codeunit
summary: Http Web Request Mgt. codeunit and its test are marked obsolete with tag 30.0, directing developers to use native HttpClient and related message classes instead.
key_points: Entire Http Web Request Mgt. codeunit wrapped in CLEAN30 conditional and marked obsolete
Test codeunit also wrapped and marked obsolete following repo convention
Pragma directives added to suppress AL0432 warnings for obsolete member signatures already marked in prior changes
No code in BCApps calls this codeunit anymore after previous PRs merged
